items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: And Celestane wasn't playing at all, then? No, Celestane.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I never heard any of his songs, but I only heard the hymns.

Well, yeah, he died, you know, a little too many times. He'd play the Eddie Jack, the old tuxedo band, and I'd have to... Yeah, and he was leading the band. Pa George was playing solo, Lewis was leading. And he was using shots, Lewis Madison was the old tuxedo. Lewis DeBan was leading the old tuxedo band. Oh, yeah, in the late days. And Celestane wasn't playing at all, then? No, Celestane. I played with the brass band. Eddie Jackson was running the band, that was... Oh, I got the idea, man. Yeah, I knew it to…

Now, say on an average funeral, how would you... How does that happen? What happens first on a funeral? Where does the band go to start? When the band goes to start, you can see the band will meet at the hall. They meet at the hall.
